changelog: Initial release: AI-optimized web search with basic/advanced modes, domain filtering, news search, image search, and AI answer generation.
summary: AI-optimized web search using Tavily Search API. Use when you need comprehensive web research, current events lookup, domain-specific search, or AI-generated answer summaries. Tavily is optimized for LLM consumption with clean structured results, answer generation, and raw content extraction. Best for research tasks, news queries, fact-checking, and gathering authoritative sources.
